items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...I see Nat Adderley and Pharaoh Sanders and Screaming Jay Hawkins... What — was there one or two things that had to be happening in the music for it to appear on Evidence Records? INTERVIEWEE: It had to be available and I had to like it.

ctx.x: I wouldn’t have done it if I didn’t think so. But opening my store it was okay — what’s my rent, what do the records cost, what can you sell them for, how many do I have to sell to meet my rent — okay, here I go, boom. It’s like walking off a cliff and you either are, you know you’re going to fly or you’re going to sink, and I never considered sinking, I couldn’t afford it.
Okay. When I look at the list of the LPs or whatever, recordings that were put out on Evidence and I see Nat Adderley and Pharaoh Sanders and Screaming Jay Hawkins and © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
Sun Ra. It’s a very diverse list. What — was there one or two things that had to be happening in the music for it to appear on Evidence Records?
